scripts.verify:reasoning:semantic-quality: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const run=spawnSync(process.execPath,['./scripts/playwright-full-scan-chat-e2e.cjs'],{encoding:'utf8',env:{...process.env,PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:'0'}});if(run.status!==0){process.stderr.write(run.stderr||run.stdout||'');process.exit(run.status||1);}let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(String(run.stdout||'{}'));}catch(e){console.error('semantic_eval_parse_failed',e.message);process.exit(2);}const a=Array.isArray(j?.transcript?.assistant)?j.transcript.assistant:[];const t1=String(a[a.length-2]||'').toLowerCase();const t2=String(a[a.length-1]||'').toLowerCase();const scanRef=/(fruit snacks|orange juice|scan|barcode|food|ingredient|product|category route)/i.test(t1);const noFallback=!/(don't see|do not see|what product did you scan|could you share.*product|what symptom or concern should we focus on next|which part of your body is affected)/i.test(t1);const continuity=/(low risk|generally safe|children|parent|practical|takeaway|product|fruit snacks|orange juice)/i.test(t2);const verdict=Boolean(j?.ok)&&scanRef&&noFallback&&continuity;console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:j?.ok||false,assertions:{scan_reference:scanRef,no_generic_fallback:noFallback,turn_continuity:continuity},verdict:verdict?'PASS':'FAIL'},null,2));process.exit(verdict?0:2);"
